gloss: puffy area under the eyes; under-eye roll

definitions.gloss: the slight puffiness just under the lower eyelid
definitions.explanation: The small swelling of muscle directly beneath the lower lashes, which grows fuller when a person smiles. In Japan it is considered attractive because it makes the eyes look larger and kinder.

notes:
USAGE:
A beauty and makeup word with a positive sense. Despite the name, it has nothing to do with tears.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {涙袋|なみだぶくろ}⟦メイク→メイク：11163_meiku⟧: makeup that emphasizes the puffiness under the eyes
- {涙袋|なみだぶくろ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ / ⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to have / not have this feature

WATCH OUT:
